title: Weis MFG x Hunt Wheels x Larry Chen
content:
The NYC-based frame builder, Weis MFG, and UK-based Hunt Wheels come together with renowned car culture and automotive photographer Larry Chen to build his dream titanium road bike to match his latest project car, a 1996 Honda Accord Sir with full 7-Eleven livery.

Debuting for the first time in person at the SEMA show in Las Vegas, Nevada. The bike matches Larry’s personal 1996 Honda Accord SiR with full 7-Eleven livery. The dedicated teams at Weis and HUNT brought the car’s unique livery and fine details to life in a fully custom paint scheme, Pantone-matched to the Accord.

The Bike – Weis Road Ti Ultralight

The Weis Road Ti Ultralight is the Brooklyn-based frame builder’s top performance machine. It pairs the elegance and lifetime reliability of titanium a carbon seat mast, uniting the most extraordinary bicycle materials into a one beautiful bicycle.

The Ultralight is built from custom-formed and butted, thin-wall 3AL/2.5V Titanium tubing, engineered for optimized ride quality, durability, and responsiveness that has defined our Titanium frames. The ovalized top tube and aero downtube, both formed in-house, create lateral stiffness to maximize power transfer and vertical compliance to keep the rider comfortable in the saddle on long rides.

Larry’s size 56 Road Ti Ultralight is the latest iteration of the model, and the custom paintjob matches to his ‘96 Accord.

The Wheels – HUNT 4AM Limitless

The HUNT 4AM Limitless, are the brand’s flagship road racing wheelset launched earlier this year. Engineered to maintain speed and composure whether on fast flats or high alpine mountain roads. By optimizing the balance between weight, aero drag, and stability, the HUNT in-house engineering team has set the standard for mid-depth road wheels.

Custom for the Larry Chen project, the team at HUNT collaborated with long-time partner, Ali Mclean at Fat Creations, to custom paint the wheels, adapting the HUNT logo to pair with the Honda branding of Larry’s car and to add a few of the car’s sponsors as an homage to the classic look and feel of the Accord. To tie it all together, HUNT opted for a fully polished silver Chase SL hub and silver spokes for this custom build.

The Car – 1996 Honda Accord SiR

Larry’s vision for this 1996 Honda Accord SiR was to combine Japanese, Thai, Indonesian, and US tuning culture together in one. What would it have looked like if 7-Eleven raced in the Japanese Touring Car Championship back in the mid-90s?

Check out more on the Ti Ultralight at Weis.
